note: Machine-readable form of APW-VECTORS-v1.3.md. This directory is independent of the code: it does not import, run or reference any implementation. The markdown is the human-readable form and both are pinned to the same spec version. License: CC BY 4.0.

notYetMachineReadable.V-06: Foreign-issuer attestation verification. Needs the full 12-step validation order, which in this reference implementation lives in packages/trust-layer (verifyAttestation), not in apw-resolver. A third party cannot yet implement V-06 from the published package alone. Blocking item for Phase 7.
notYetMachineReadable.V-07: Site-signed JWS. The verification routine is public (verifySiteJws) but the vectors are mutation matrices over bytes, so they are expressed as prose; they become mechanical once the fixture format supports byte-level mutation.
notYetMachineReadable.V-10: R-05 calibration (leave-one-out, 8 rounds). The routine is public (calibrateJudges, scoreSubject) and reproducible, but the scenarios need per-subject attestation fixtures; scheduled for the second pass.
notYetMachineReadable.V-11: Read policy and visibility. Requires a database and a policy table; the decision function is not pure, so it does not fit a vector file without a harness.
notYetMachineReadable.V-13: Witnesses. The deterministic jti preimage is public and vectorisable; the evaluation matrix needs chain fixtures. Partially scheduled for the second pass.
